authors: Mohammadali Sefidi Esfahani, Fahimeh Hajari, Ehsan Mirsaeedi, Peter Rigby
description: Replication package for 'The Cost vs. the Benefit of Adding an Extra Code Reviewer to Mitigate Developer Turnover through Reviewer Recommenders' paper, which is published in the ICSE'26. Compared to the SofiaWL package, we implement the necessary methods to suggest an additional reviewer for Pull Requests with Knowledge at Risk (PRKRs) based on diverse recommendation strategies. This package is based on RelationalGit, which can extract valuable information about commits, blame, changes, developers, and pull requests from Git's data structure and import it into a relational database, such as Microsoft SQL Server. These data can be a ground for further source code mining analysis.
title: SofiaWL-LearnerPlusPlus
